files.description: Product returns in March (80 rows): return_id (whole number), quantity (whole number), refund (two decimals). Same columns as returns_april.csv.
Product returns in April: the header row (return_id, quantity, refund, as in returns_march.csv) and no data rows, because nothing was returned in April.

task_text: Combine the March and April returns into one table and round every refund to a whole currency unit. `result` should be the combined table with the columns return_id, quantity and refund.
intended_computation: All 80 returns (April has none) with return_id and quantity unchanged and refund rounded to 0 decimals (halves rounded to even or away from zero).

acceptable_variants.notes: row order is free; rounded refunds may be whole numbers or decimals ending in .0; rounding half to even and half away from zero are both accepted

predicted_direction.reason: DataFrame.round(0) rounded the numeric refund column on 2.x; on 3.x the combined columns are text-like and round() leaves them unchanged.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
